newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran government employees held for taking bribes.
newsitem.headline: Iran government employees held for taking bribes.

text.p: Twenty government employees in a poor suburb of Tehran have been arrested for taking bribes, the English-language Iran News paper reported on Monday.
Those arrested included officials responsible for security in the Tehran working-class area of Robatkarim and a district mayor, Iran News said.
"The mayor of the district of Sultan-Abad, whose name was not disclosed, is among those being prosecuted," the paper, quoting local press reports, said.
